spec.description: Introduce a mechanism so that all request and app-context teardown callbacks run even if earlier ones raise exceptions. On Python 3.11+, raise collected errors as a BaseExceptionGroup
On older Python versions, re-raise the first collected error
Update both request context and app context teardown handling
Add comprehensive test coverage for error collection across multiple teardown callbacks
